title: 美银Winnie：估值重估还是基本面破位？资金转向防御与下游
speaker: Winnie

segments.en: Do you think this is more of a valuation reset, or do you think fundamentally there is something that is breaking down now, too?
segments.zh: 你认为这更像是估值重估，还是基本面也出现了问题？

segments.en: I think it's both, right? As of now, valuation is reflecting probably more of the longer term, not next quarter,
segments.zh: 我认为两者都有。目前估值可能更多反映长期，而非下季度，

segments.en: but it's the two, three-year larger cycle question.
segments.zh: 而是两到三年的大周期问题。

segments.en: So, that's why we will say markets with a bigger domestic economy, less rely on export, you know, so the larger market, like, you know, Japan, China, India are structurally better position,
segments.zh: 因此，内需更大的市场，出口依赖较低，如日本、中国、印度，结构上更具优势，

segments.en: at least there's domestic consumption, there's financial sector, there's other sectors to play with, a health care, right?
segments.zh: 至少有国内消费、金融板块和其他板块可布局，比如医疗保健，对吧？

segments.en: Second, I think generally we want to play defensive, right?
segments.zh: 其次，总体而言我们倾向于防御，对吧？

segments.en: So, the dividend yield stocks are important, and to some extent that's why China banks are now, like, the consensus overweight, everyone loves China banks now,
segments.zh: 因此，股息率高的权益资产很重要，某种程度上这就是为什么中国银行股现在成为共识增持，大家都喜欢，

segments.en: and as we discussed before, it's not only the dividend yield itself, but it's also the certainty of the DPS, right?
segments.zh: 正如我们之前讨论的，不仅是股息率本身，还有每股股息的确定性，对吧？

segments.en: And the beauty of the banks has been that their earnings certainty is very, very high.
segments.zh: 银行股的优势在于其盈利确定性非常高。

segments.en: So, beta is low, so the defensive part is also very important.
segments.zh: 因此，贝塔值低，防御性也很重要。

segments.en: But also, the third element, I think people are considering, is the upstream versus downstream.
segments.zh: 但第三个要素，我认为人们正在考虑的是上游与下游的对比。

segments.en: All right, for the past two, three years, the trade is by the pick and shovel place, right?
segments.zh: 过去两三年，交易策略是围绕卖铲子的地方，对吧？

segments.en: By the upstream infrastructure, because regardless which model wins, they will need more memories, they will need more cooling, they will need more PCBs.
segments.zh: 围绕上游基础设施，因为无论哪种模式胜出，他们都需要更多存储、更多冷却、更多PCB。

segments.en: But now, the fear is that upstream, the mode, some of them might not be that high after all, and there's the Chinese competition in some of the sectors,
segments.zh: 但现在，担忧在于上游模式，其中一些可能终究没那么高，而且某些领域存在中国竞争，

segments.en: there's the capacity built out, whereas everyone has been underweight some of the downstream, right?
segments.zh: 产能已经建好，而大家一直低配一些下游，对吧？

segments.en: Ranging from consumer electronics to the application names, so maybe people are looking to rebalance, right?
segments.zh: 从消费电子到应用类公司，所以也许人们正在寻求再平衡，对吧？

segments.en: Neutralize the upgrade on the upstream infrastructure and looking to re-evaluate the downstream stories.
segments.zh: 中和上游基础设施的升级，并重新评估下游的故事。

segments.en: The issue is, as you know, people are trying to figure out what 20-28 earnings looks like.
segments.zh: 问题是，如你所知，人们正试图弄清楚2028年的盈利情况。
